biography: Ricardo Basso, born in the vibrant favelas of São Paulo, Brazil, didn't grow up dreaming of pristine circuits. His racing career began on the dusty, makeshift dirt tracks carved into the hillsides outside the city. His first 'car' was a cobbled-together go-kart powered by a lawnmower engine, a prize he won in a local street race at the age of 14. It was there, amidst the cheers of his community and the ever-present dust, that Ricardo discovered his raw talent and unyielding passion. He quickly gained a reputation for his audacious overtakes and fearless driving, catching the eye of Formula Dirt scouts during a regional championship. Signing with them was a dream come true, a chance to leave the favelas behind and make a name for himself. While his early performances showed promise, a few costly errors under pressure have tempered expectations, and he is now focused on refining his skills and proving he belongs at the top.
drivingStyle: Basso's driving style is characterized by aggression and instinct. He's a late-braking specialist, often diving into corners with a level of commitment that borders on reckless. While this approach can yield spectacular results, it also leads to inconsistencies and the occasional costly mistake. He tends to overdrive the car, relying on his natural talent to wrestle it back into control, rather than preserving tire life. Basso thrives under pressure, often delivering his best performances when the stakes are highest, although this can also lead to rash decisions.

rivalries.reason: Rossi criticized Basso's aggressive driving after a controversial collision that cost her a podium finish.
Tanaka is Basso's teammate, and they are constantly battling for the team's number-one driver spot.
Dubois, a veteran driver, sees Basso as a reckless newcomer who disrespects racing etiquette.

quirks: Always wears the same lucky bracelet given to him by his grandmother.
Listens to samba music at full volume right before the race to get pumped up.
Refuses to eat anything green on race day, believing it brings bad luck.
famousQuote: "Life's too short to drive slow. You gotta send it!"
careerHighlight: Winning the Brazilian National Dirt Championship in 2022, a victory that opened the door to Formula Dirt and made him a local hero.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead on the final lap of the 2023 Monsoon Mayhem race due to overconfidence in wet conditions, losing valuable championship points.
